subject: Exec sponsor request: temporary rate shelter for feature slip
body_preview: Acme asked for short-term rate relief due to delayed multi-model runtime feature. Proposal: temporary rate shelter (timeboxed credit) pending exec signoff.
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Launch timing + commercial ask

Hi Grace / Marissa,

Quick update from our side: the engineering team at Acme just pushed our multi-model integration out by ~6 weeks due to a missing compatibility shim. That slip materially affects our Q1 rollout timing and budget authorization. We understand this is partly on our side, but we were counting on Redwood's new long-sequence optimizer to hit production in time — which it won't for us.

Can Redwood provide a short-term commercial accommodation (either a temporary rate reduction or a usage credit) to bridge the gap until the optimizer ships? This is a gating item for our procurement to close the PO this month.

We value the platform and want to keep momentum; appreciate any constructive options.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sr. Program Manager, Acme Corp
[Attachment: integration-failure-log.txt (TXT, 14KB)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Launch timing + commercial ask — proposal for temporary "rate shelter"

Team,

Forwarding Acme's ask. I spoke to Marissa briefly — they need a commercial signal to unblock procurement this week. Product confirms the long-sequence optimizer (LS-Opt) will miss Acme's timeline by ~6 weeks. We need an internal path to offer a timeboxed accommodation that:

- preserves revenue recognition and limits downside for Redwood
- is simple and can be documented quickly (SOW addendum / short DocuSign)
- ties to delivery milestones so it automatically sunsets

Proposed approach (see attached v2):
- Offer a "rate shelter": a rebate of 20% on token usage for up to 3 months OR a fixed $40k usage credit applied over the next billing cycle (whichever is lower).
- Eligibility: usage tied to the pilot account; credit only if they remain on current committed plan.
- Sunset: auto-terminate when LS-Opt is available or at 3 months, whichever comes first.

Attachments: proposed-shelter-term-v2.pdf (draft), demo_recording.mp4 (context).

Asking: finance + legal to confirm accounting & drafting lift. Karthik, can you confirm sales stance? Rishi — can you be exec sponsor for quick sign-off if finance + legal are ok? I can prepare a 1-pager for your review.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed-shelter-term-v2.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Fwd: Launch timing + commercial ask — proposal for temporary "rate shelter"

Thanks Grace — that framing is sensible. A few notes from GTM/product perspective:

- We should make the accommodation explicitly timeboxed and milestone-linked (agree with the sunset clause).
- Suggest including a soft cap on eligible usage (e.g., first 2M tokens) to prevent open-ended exposure.
- Product would like a signal from Acme that they won't pursue an expanded commit in lieu of the credit (we don't want them to double-dip).

If finance & legal are comfortable, I support Rishi taking the exec nod to approve the exception. Grace — please draft a one-page summary (terms, cap, milestones, customer ask, and why we make the accommodation) — I'll add a short sales note.

Karthik
VP, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Fwd: Launch timing + commercial ask — proposal for temporary "rate shelter"

Appreciate the clear proposal. Finance perspective:

- We can accommodate a timeboxed rebate but would prefer a smaller percent or a firm credit cap. Recommend: 15% rebate capped at $30k OR a $30k fixed credit.
- Need to confirm revenue recognition treatment with accounting; if it is a refundable/conditional credit we need a supporting SOW addendum.
- Agree on a 2M token soft cap for eligibility.

If legal can draft a tight addendum, finance can mark as "approved pending exec signoff". Please include the accounting treatment line in the one-pager for Rishi.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: finance-guidance-note.docx (DOCX, 12KB)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 17:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Fwd: Launch timing + commercial ask — proposal for temporary "rate shelter"

All — I reviewed the summary and attachments. I approve the timeboxed accommodation on the terms below:

- 15% rebate capped at $30k OR $30k fixed credit (customer choice)
- Eligibility restricted to pilot usage with 2M token soft cap
- Sunset at 3 months or when LS-Opt is available
- Legal to finalise an addendum and Finance to confirm accounting language before signature

Stephanie — please prepare the SOW addendum and DocuSign package. Grace / Marissa — once finalized, send to Sarah with the DocuSign link and note that this is a one-time, non-precedential accommodation.

Approved — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
[Inline reply quoting Grace's 1-pager]
